Hi Claire — thanks again for the interest in Redwood.

Quick note: the execs on your side asked for a live, short walkthrough focused on latency and cost controls. Can we do 45 minutes tomorrow, 11/24 at 10:00am PT?

Proposed agenda (attached):
- 5m quick intros
- 20m live demo (model routing, batching controls)
- 10m ROI/cost controls overview
- 10m Q&A

Sofia — can you and Karthik cover the demo? If Karthik is on travel, can Sofia run the live bits and Karthik join for Q&A?

Hi team — heads up, I'm on a flight that lands 11/24 09:50am PT and I have a back-to-back customer call at 11:15am PT. I won't be in a good position to lead the live demo at 10:00am and want to avoid doing it while taxiing.

Options I see:
1) Sofia runs the live demo at 10:00am (I join at 11:20am PT for Q&A — short handoff). I can prepare a 2-slide deep-dive note to hand off.
2) Move the session to 11/24 2:00pm PT (I can be there live).
3) Keep 10:00am and record the demo; then do a 20m live follow-up next week for the execs.

I'd prefer option 1 if the execs insist on a same-day live. Sofia — can you take point? I will send my handoff note and a short recording fallback in case of connectivity issues.

Thanks,
Karthik

Hi Marissa / Redwood team — thanks for the quick turnaround. The execs really want someone live for the entire demo; they want to ask architecture-level questions during the demo and prefer not to wait until Q&A.

If Karthik can't be the main presenter, could Sofia lead and have Karthik on the line the whole time even if he's joining a few minutes late? Our group is flexible on a total length of 35–45 minutes; we mostly care about having a live expert available for deep questions.

Alternative times tomorrow that could work for us: 11/24 9:00–9:45am PT (tighter, earlier) or 11/24 2:00–2:45pm PT. If none of these work, we can do the recording + follow-up live next week, but it's lower preference.

Attendees: Claire Park (Product), Daniel Ho (CTO), Priya Menon (Data).

Marissa / Karthik — I can absolutely lead the session if the execs need someone live for the full demo.

Plan I'd suggest to keep everything smooth:
- I'll take the demo at 10:00am PT.
- Karthik, please send the 2-slide deep-dive and any starter script you want me to emphasize; if you can dial in even a minute or two late, I'll flag the deep questions for you as they come up.
- I'll keep the live demo condensed to 30 minutes: 8m intros + 18m focused live demo + 4–8m quick Q&A. If the execs want extended follow-up, we'll pencil a short deep-dive with Karthik next week.

I attached a short internal note I wrote with the fallback recording points and the bits to highlight for the execs (latency SLOs, batch/caching toggles, routing policies).

I'll also update the agenda and send a calendar hold once Marissa confirms attendee list.
